item.description: How did Prof Abimbola Windapo, once crippled by depression despite her academic success, find healing and rise to become Africa’s top woman in construction?

item.description: How did Billy Robertson's jagged path from rugby heartbreak to healing lead to a career that had been prophesied for him as a child?

item.title: Marcél Roux: faith, fatherhood and finding peace
item.description: He didn’t actually enter the Mr South Africa competition himself, but Marcél Roux walked away with the title! What is the heart of this rugby-playing youth pastor, and how did he find peace after hitting rock bottom as a teen?

item.title: Kim Ballantine lost her voice for six years
item.description: She suddenly lost her voice, and her world collapsed. How did industrial psychologist Kim Ballantine rebuild her life, parent her young children and keep her marriage going when further health challenges and depression struck? And how did her voice finally return six long years later?

item.title: The Rea Thusana wow house where women rise!
item.description: They hit rock bottom and found themselves living on the streets, their worlds unravelling day by day. Then a door opened to something entirely different, a place of safety, community and the chance to start afresh. At a halfway house in Cape Town's Wynberg, Jou-anne and Michell were given that opportunity. How has it helped them work on themselves, find employment and get back on their feet?
